from pathlib import Path
import csv, json
source=Path('/app/catalogue-1.csv')
output=Path('/app/catalogue-1-summary.json')
lines=source.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines()
header=next(csv.reader([lines[0]]))
expected=len(header)
complete=0
anomalies=[]
for line_number,line in enumerate(lines[1:],2):
    row=next(csv.reader([line]))
    if len(row)==expected and all(field.strip() for field in row):
        complete+=1
    else:
        anomalies.append({'line':line_number,'column_count':len(row),'record_id':row[0] if row else None,'kind':'blank_line' if not line.strip() else 'column_count_mismatch'})
fragment=lines[-1] if lines[-1].strip() and len(next(csv.reader([lines[-1]])))"'!=expected else None
summary={'"'source':'catalogue-1.csv','columns':header,'expected_column_count':expected,'complete_records':complete,'column_count_anomalies':anomalies,'incomplete_last_line_fragment':fragment}
output.write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\\n',encoding='utf-8')
Path('/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md').write_text('Batch 1 catalogue summary written to /app/catalogue-1-summary.json. Independent validation pending.\\n')
print({'summary_path':str(output),'complete_records':complete,'anomaly_count':len(anomalies),'incomplete_last_line_fragment':fragment})
PY"
